dataset.assembly_selection: Extracted RNA chains; original assembly annotations retained; strict biological monomer selection not performed

c3_rmsd.name: C3′ RMSD
c3_rmsd.definition: US-align native aligned-region C3′ RMSD on original structures; default alignment

rna_tm_score.name: RNA TM-score
rna_tm_score.definition: US-align default RNA structure alignment on original files; reference-length normalization

heavy_atom_lddt.name: 全重原子 lDDT
heavy_atom_lddt.definition: OpenStructure original files; --lddt -rna; default stereochecks, radius and minimum nucleotide length
